goal: Choose localRateTable or the opt-in stripeTax adapter bound to TaxCalculationPort in application composition.

absentMeans.description: Exclusive tax calculation requires an explicit binding for the selected scope, market and currency.

whyThisDefault: The application owns the market and account for its tax calculations.

effect.appliesTo: The bound TaxCalculationPort supplies amounts, coverage decisions and evidence for new exclusive tax quotes.
frozenOn: Existing calculations keep their adapter scope and evidence.

runtime.reason: Change the binding in application composition and qualify it with the offline conformance kit.

goal: Map application tax classes to provider tax codes in the versioned market pack.

absentMeans.description: An unmapped class refuses the quote before provider I/O.

whyThisDefault: Each market pack owns the mapping for its catalogue and provider.

effect.appliesTo: New evaluations use the provider code for each frozen tax class.
frozenOn: Existing receipts retain their class-map revision and calculation evidence.

runtime.reason: Version the taxCodes mapping and classMapRevision passed in the adapter's market pack.

goal: Supply effective rules for each jurisdiction, tax class and kind when binding the local rate table.

absentMeans.description: A missing effective rule refuses the quote, including on zero-priced components.

whyThisDefault: Each application supplies its own effective rules and legal basis.

effect.appliesTo: localRateTable uses effective intervals, exact decimal-percent rates, explicit exemptions, or fixed fees with refund rules. It applies half-up rounding with largest-remainder allocation and carries the table digest in calculation evidence.
frozenOn: Existing calculations keep their recorded amounts, rules and evidence.

runtime.reason: Version the LocalRateTableOptionsV1 rules and registration evidence in the pack or application composition.
